name: Necromancer bench: Command: Blight lets a commanded kill give experience with no swing
contract: SoloKill.RequirePlayerHit (#10365) gives an ungrouped player experience from a creature only if the player registered a hit on it. Order() (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:405) drives the minion but may not register that hit. Raise: Decaying Colossus 500989 (3 Life Force) summons creature 50115; its capacity needs Scourge Apprentice Training 680283 (base 2 -> 3). Command: Blight 504050 is gated by CharacterAdvancement 33764 (Tab 87 'Class', AbilityEssenceCost 1, RequiredEntry all 0, but TabAEInvestment 24: it needs 24 Ability Essence already spent in the shared Class tab, which a full real purchase chain of other Class-tab nodes would have to fund) and is one of the three command-special-cased ids in DoAction() (casts self-buff 801534), distinct from the plain-trainer-learnable 504863 on the same minion. The spell is learned directly, bypassing the CA/tab-investment acquisition gate, for mechanics-only testing of the minion-order path (matrix-documented fallback). The Necromancer raises one Decaying Colossus, orders Command: Blight at a creature, never swings, and the Colossus alone kills it. This bench checks whether the necromancer still gains experience from that kill.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
Bypass the CharacterAdvancement 33764 / TabAEInvestment 24 gate for mechanics-only testing
SETUP: Life Force capacity is raised to 3
SETUP: one Decaying Colossus is raised
Let the Colossus take its formation place and the global cooldown pass
Select the creature so Order() finds it through GetTarget() (504050's own effect targets the caster)
SETUP: the Command cast went through
SETUP: the Colossus kills the creature
BENCH: the commanded kill gives experience
BENCH: the experience did not cross a level
